description: This PHP source file defines the EducationDao class, which manages database interactions related to Education entities, including CRUD operations, querying by various filters, and soft deletion, within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EducationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing Education entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, retrieval, filtering, and soft delete within the HRM system.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Persists an Education entity to the database and returns the persisted object.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingEducationIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs that exist from a list of given IDs.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity matching the given name.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Returns a list of Education entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEducationListPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for Education list according to search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Education entities matching the search filter.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Soft deletes Education entries by updating their status, based on provided IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an Education name already exists in the database.
